statement: After terminal retryable durable-rejoin cleanup, the bounded entrypoint outer reattempt has one canonical live lifecycle owner, restores every admission side effect invalidated by cleanup exactly once before readiness, resumes the same durable session, survives an inner readiness retry without repeating restored membership, and the registered deterministic guard passes three consecutive runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Transfer NodeService ownership only by compare-and-swap from the exact same-node STOPPED lifecycle object supplied by the entrypoint's failed outer attempt to the newly constructed service lifecycle; reject an unknown, live, wrong-node, or already-replaced owner.

A satisfied membership checkpoint may rerun only after the exact predecessor transfer proves terminal outer cleanup invalidated its admission side effects; reconstruct cleaned process-local infrastructure, restore membership and message-group activation once, clear the restoration requirement only after success, and skip those owners on later inner retries.

Deterministic evidence must use real NodeJoiningService cleanup, JoinCoordinator, and durable session storage: outer attempt one reaches MEMBERSHIP_WRITTEN, withdraws JOINING/connected membership to STOPPED/disconnected, and stops its lifecycle; outer attempt two resolves the same session, restores JOINING/connected before readiness, survives one inner readiness retry without a second withdrawal or membership restore, and reaches ACTIVE/connected plus READY.

FINALIZED and steady-state background-writer activation must not succeed unless NodeService is bound to the current joining lifecycle, that lifecycle confirms READY, and the restored local membership is active; invalid ownership or withdrawn membership must surface as failure.
Do not remove or downgrade canonical-owner assertions, accept an unknown predecessor, mutate lifecycle state directly, synthesize READY, or change join/readiness timeout and retry budgets.
Fresh joins, failures before NodeService initialization, same-service inner retry, same-state READY idempotence, and terminal non-retryable cleanup retain their existing behavior.
